inlineMultimodal.title: Inline multimodal content
inlineMultimodal.description: Sync media embedded within notes. Currently supports images in Notion and SiYuan.
inlineMultimodal.policyHelp: Images are synced only when both inline media and Images in the file type policy are enabled.
inlineMultimodal.inactive: Notes will sync as text only. Enable both inline media and Images in file types to include images.

providerCopy.steamDescription: Steam Web API key for profiles, games and achievements
providerCopy.steamApiKeyHelp: Create a user API key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Private friends and achievements may be unavailable.
providerCopy.steamIdHelp: Numeric Steam account ID. Syncs one profile and one document per game; successful empty libraries remove existing game documents.
providerCopy.steamSyncHelp: Normal sync refreshes active and new games. Full reconciliation refreshes all games, including inactive games.
providerCopy.webcalDescription: iCalendar subscription for events and to-dos
providerCopy.webcalURLHelp: The subscription URL is encrypted. HTTP, HTTPS, and webcal protocols are supported.
providerCopy.webcalSnapshotHelp: Full snapshots delete missing documents, including an empty calendar. A rolling subscription window also removes older documents.
providerCopy.webcalSeriesHelp: For recurring series with rolling windows, allow open boundaries: start time is missing or before window end, and end boundary is missing or after window start.
providerCopy.cloudflareCredentialHelp: Cloudflare account and API token with Browser Run Edit permission
providerCopy.cloudflareRenderHelp: Enable for websites whose content loads in the browser. Browser execution time may be billed.
providerCopy.cloudflareLimitHelp: Free accounts allow up to 100 pages per crawl. Reaching the page limit prevents deletion reconciliation.
providerCopy.cloudflareCacheHelp: Full reconciliation always fetches fresh content.
providerCopy.cloudflareIncludeHelp: One pattern per line. * matches within a path segment; ** matches across segments.
providerCopy.imapDescription: Email account using a password or app password
providerCopy.emailBodyHelp: Attachments are listed without downloading. Oversized bodies retain headers and a warning.
providerCopy.emailFoldersHelp: Missing emails are cleaned up after a successful complete scan. Default folders: INBOX and server-designated Sent.

providerCopy.notionDescription: Notion internal integration token with read access to shared data sources
providerCopy.siYuanDescription: SiYuan kernel API endpoint and token (Settings → About → API token)

providerCopy.oneDriveDescription: Microsoft account / Microsoft 365 via OAuth (OneDrive and SharePoint)

providerCopy.webdavDescription: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology, Apache mod_dav, rclone serve, …
providerCopy.hindsightDescription: Hindsight API endpoint used as a destination
providerCopy.filesystemRootHelp: Absolute path on the application server. In Docker, use the mounted container path.
providerCopy.filesystemFolderHelp: Relative to the credential's root directory. Use . for the root.
providerCopy.notionDataSourceHelp: Notion data source ID (not the database ID). Use Browse to pick one shared with the integration.
providerCopy.siYuanInstanceHelp: Stable identifier for this SiYuan instance. Leave empty to use its base URL.
providerCopy.s3EndpointHelp: Leave empty to use AWS S3.
providerCopy.s3PathStyleHelp: Required by most self-hosted S3 servers (e.g. MinIO).
providerCopy.s3PrefixHelp: Only objects under this key prefix.
providerCopy.webdavTokenHelp: Use instead of username/password if the server expects a token.
providerCopy.webdavRootHelp: Path relative to the server URL.
providerCopy.googleDriveHelp: Leave empty for My Drive, or pick a shared drive.
providerCopy.wholeDriveHelp: Leave empty for the whole drive.
providerCopy.googleExportHelp: Docs → Markdown, Sheets → CSV, Slides → PDF.
providerCopy.tenantHelp: common, organizations, consumers, or a tenant ID.
providerCopy.oneDriveHelp: Leave empty for your personal OneDrive.
providerCopy.siYuanPathHelp: Only documents whose human-readable path starts with this prefix.
providerCopy.siYuanNotebookHelp: Leave empty to sync every open notebook.
providerCopy.hindsightApiKeyHelp: Sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty if the instance has no authentication.

observationScope.title: Observation scope
observationScope.inheritHelp: Follow the observation scope configured in global settings.

descriptions.combined: Consolidate once using all tags together. Observations belong to the full tag set, keeping knowledge specific to that combination.
descriptions.shared: Consolidate into one global, untagged scope across memories with different tags. Useful when session tags should not separate shared knowledge.
descriptions.per_tag: Consolidate separately for each tag. Each tag builds independent observations across memories, without creating scopes for tag combinations.
descriptions.all_combinations: Consolidate for every non-empty subset of tags, including individual tags and combinations. For example, three tags create seven distinct scopes and seven consolidation passes.
descriptions.custom: Choose the exact tag groups to consolidate. Each group creates one independent scope, avoiding combinations you do not need.

observationScope.customHelp: Add at least one tag to each scope. Use dynamic tags to follow the current task, source, or source group; choose Shared for a global, untagged scope.
observationScope.emptyGroup: Add at least one tag to each scope.
observationScope.exponentialWarning: Scopes can grow exponentially: n tags produce 2ⁿ − 1 scopes per document, increasing processing time and cost.
observationScope.fileLimitation: Observation scopes apply to text and inline content. File uploads use Combined scope.
observationScope.tagsUnavailable: Could not load bank tags. You can still enter a tag manually.
